{{Quote|We're losing it, sir!|The clone pilot, about the collapsing bridge of ''Endurance''|<ref name="r2ch" />}}
This '''clone trooper pilot''' flew one of three [[Plo's Bros/Legends|''Plo's Bros'']] gunships sent to [[Vanqor/Legends|Vanqor]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] to rescue [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] and [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]].

==Biography==
Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], following a distress message delivered by [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] to the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] and [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] departed to rescue fellow Jedi Anakin Skywalker and Mace Windu, who were injured and trapped on Vanqor. This clone pilot flew the [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i]] carrying [[Jedi General/Legends|General]] Koon, [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Commander]] Tano and members of the [[Wolfpack/Legends|Wolfpack]] to aid in extracting their comrades from the crashed [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Endurance/Legends|''Endurance'']].<ref name="r2ch" />
